explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/786: can one find A ⊆ {1,…,N} with the property and size ≥ (1-o(1))N? This is the distinct-elements version, open (the version with repetition is false, by Ruzsa/ERS and Granville–Soundararajan). The statement uses A N ⊆ [1, N+1] rather than [1, N], an off-by-one that is immaterial asymptotically, with |A N| ≥ (1 - f N)N for f = o(1). Faithful.
